sloka: तं तोलयित्वा बाहुभ्यां गतसत्त्वमचेतनम् ।चिक्षेप बलवान्वाली वेगेनैकेन योजनम् ॥४-११-४७॥।।
transliteration: taṁ tolayitvā bāhubhyāṁ gatasattvamacetanam ।cikṣepa balavānvālī vegenaikena yojanam ॥4-11-47॥।।

translations.english: 'Mighty Vali lifted on both shoulders the insensate body drained of life and hurled it speedily to a distance of a yojana.
